candidate.statement: Test whether measured ionic and exchangeable-proton inventories couple amine/imine branching and reversible catalyst dormancy through shared identified species, enabling locked intervention and second-scaffold predictions.
prior_art_covers: Changing active-catalyst populations and history dependence
Competitive kinetics and predictive off-cycle models
Nonstandard free energies and operational reaction-network modeling
required_new_evidence: Identified shared chemical species in the same borrowing-hydrogen system
Interventions discriminating shared mediation from parallel responses
Predictions of species and product trajectories
Frozen mapping to a second chemically distinct ligand scaffold
Useful control beyond fair same-data baselines
decisive_downgrades: Second scaffold fails without informative error bounds
Only already-known cation or base-restoration effects are reproduced
